content.title: Ozempic® (semaglutide) injection 0.5 mg, 1 mg, 2 mg List Price & Insurance Coverage Explained
content.text: Find out the cost for Ozempic® The amount you pay for Ozempic® depends on your insurance plan. Check to see how much it will cost for you. The red label pen shown delivers doses of 0.25 mg or 0.5 mg. What can I expect to pay? See if your insurance covers Ozempic® in just a few minutes. You can also find out how much it might cost. What is the list price for Ozempic® and will it impact me? List price is the original price set for a medication by a manufacturer before any discounts or rebates are applied. However, most people don’t pay list price if they have health insurance. Ozempic® 0.25 or 0.5 mg (1 x 1.5-mL pen) = $1,027.51 Ozempic® 1 mg (1 x 3-mL pen) = $1,027.51 Ozempic® 2 mg (1 x 3-mL pen) = $1,027.51 Ozempic® 0.25 or 0.5 mg (1 x 1.5-mL pen) = $997.58 Ozempic® 1 mg (1 x 3-mL pen) = $997.58 Ozempic® 2 mg (1 x 3-mL pen) = $997.58 Have more questions about the cost of Ozempic®? Call 1-888-693-6742 for more information. More details and a savings offer How much you pay depends on your health insurance plan, the list of drugs your plan covers, and how much of your deductible you’ve already paid. You usually pay more before you’ve met your deductible. If you have Part D coverage, you may be eligible for the Low Income Subsidy (LIS)/Extra Help program.b See if you qualify for the LIS/Extra Help program. bReference source based on CMS website. Please verify with the individual plan sponsors for coverage and updated information. Information is subject to change without notice. You can have Ozempic® shipped directly to your home with NovoCare® Pharmacy.c You might be able to get a savings offer that you can use at your local pharmacy when you pick up your medicine. cCoAssist Pharmacy d/b/a NovoCare® Pharmacy. If eligible, you may be able to get Ozempic® at no cost through the Patient Assistance Program.
